# Probe corpus for tests/delete_guard_differential.py: one command per line, as
# `<HOME|REPO|DEEP|SCRIPTS|CODE|OUTSIDE> <command>`, the working folder named after the fixture
# folders of tests/delete_guard_cases.py. Seeded from the three independent reviews of the first
# attempt at issue #4; add the probes of every later review. Lines starting with # are comments.
REPO timeout -s TRAP 5 rm -rf ~
REPO find ~ -exec timeout -s TRAP 5 rm -rf {} +
REPO ls | xargs timeout -s TRAP 5 rm -rf
REPO env -u TRAP rm -rf ~/Library
REPO pushd ~; pushd /tmp/x; popd && rm .zshrc
REPO pushd ~; pushd /tmp/x; pushd && rm .zshrc

REPO cd -1 && rm .zshrc
REPO cd ~; cd -5 && rm .zshrc

REPO cd /tmp/1; cd /tmp/2; cd /tmp/3; cd /tmp/4; cd /tmp/5; cd /tmp/6; cd /tmp/7; cd /tmp/8; cd ~ && true || true && rm .zshrc
REPO function f { $DEL -rf ~/Library; }; f
REPO f() { $DEL -rf ~/Library; }; f

REPO trap 'rm -rf *' EXIT; cd ~
REPO noglob cd ~ && rm -rf Documents
REPO nocorrect cd ~ && rm -rf Documents

DEEP cd a/b/deep Documents && rm -rf *

REPO export CDPATH=~; cd Documents && rm -rf *
REPO repeat 5 cd ..; rm -rf Documents
SCRIPTS repeat 5 cd ..; rm -rf Documents

SCRIPTS foreach i (1 2 3 4 5) cd ..; end; rm -rf Documents

SCRIPTS for i in 1 2 3 4 5; cd ..; rm -rf Documents
SCRIPTS for i (1 2 3 4 5) cd ..; rm -rf Documents
SCRIPTS for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do rm -rf Documents; builtin cd ..; done
SCRIPTS for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do rm -rf Documents; eval cd ..; done
SCRIPTS for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do rm -rf Documents; pushd .. ; done
SCRIPTS while true; do rm -rf Documents; cd .. || break; done
SCRIPTS until false; do rm -rf Documents; cd ..; done

REPO time trap 'echo "' EXIT; function g { cd ~; }; g; rm -rf Documents
REPO - trap 'x"' EXIT; trap 'rm -rf Documents' EXIT; cd ~
REPO function g { cd ~; }; g; rm -rf Documents
REPO time trap 'echo "' EXIT; rm -rf {~,x}/Documents
REPO cd build && rm -rf CMakeFiles && cd ..
REPO for d in a b c; do (cd "$d" && rm -rf node_modules); done
REPO for d in a b c; do cd "$d"; rm -rf dist; cd ..; done
REPO pushd build && rm -rf out && popd
REPO pushd build >/dev/null; rm -rf out; popd >/dev/null; rm -rf target
REPO cd target || exit 1; rm -rf debug
REPO cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP"; }; TMP=$(mktemp -d); trap cleanup EXIT; cd "$TMP" && touch x
REPO T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$T"' EXIT; cd "$T"; git clone x .
REPO set -e; trap 'rm -rf build' EXIT; make
REPO time rm -rf build
REPO rm -rf build; cd ..; ls
REPO cd /tmp/x && rm -rf * && cd -
REPO cd ~/My\ projects/repo && rm -rf build
REPO rm -rf ~+/build
REPO rm -rf ${OUT:-build}
REPO eval "$(direnv export bash)"; rm -rf build
REPO source .venv/bin/activate && rm -rf build
REPO cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && rm -rf build
REPO git worktree list; cd ../repo && rm -rf target/debug
SCRIPTS cd ../../.. && rm -rf build
SCRIPTS pushd ../.. && rm -rf build; popd
REPO while read f; do rm -f "$f"; done < list.txt
REPO for f in *.log; do rm -f "$f"; done
REPO trap 'rm -f /tmp/x.lock' EXIT; cd ..; ls
REPO f() { rm -rf build; }; f; cd ..; ls
REPO cd build; rm -rf out; cd -; rm -rf dist
